codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly replaces the deprecated @app.on_event('startup') with a modern lifespan context manager using contextlib.asynccontextmanager. The FastAPI deprecation warning is eliminated, vector store loads correctly during startup (190 chunks), and all 53 tests pass with no warnings.

summary: The fix successfully addresses the FastAPI deprecation warning by implementing proper lifespan hooks. The implementation follows FastAPI best practices: uses @asynccontextmanager decorator, properly structures startup (before yield) and shutdown (after yield) phases, and passes the lifespan function to the FastAPI constructor. All functionality is preserved - vector store loads correctly with 190 chunks, CORS middleware works, and the entire test suite passes without deprecation warnings.
